title.zh: BNY与Citadel Securities测试代币化美国国债，以加速华尔街融资
title.en: BNY, Citadel Securities test tokenized U.S. Treasuries to speed up Wall Street financing

current_state.zh:
被称为全球最大托管银行的BNY与交易巨头Citadel Securities周二表示，双方已完成一笔使用代币化美国国债的交易，展示基于区块链的政府债券如何从结算环节进入融资环节。BNY还表示计划增加数字现金和代币化存款能力，并延长其面向美联储合格证券及美国三方交易的既有结算系统的运营时间，目标是在明年覆盖欧洲和亚洲交易时段。

该尝试针对的是金融市场的一个关键瓶颈：作为交易和借贷抵押品的政府债券在账户与结算系统之间转移需要时间，从而占用本可另作他用的资产。Citadel Securities数字资产业务运营负责人Dan Doherty表示，高质量抵押品的高效流转是市场良好运行的基础，减少交易生命周期中的延迟可以改善机构市场的运作方式。

这笔交易旨在演示代币化政府债券如何从结算进入融资环节，从而可能让机构更早地重复使用抵押品，并释放现金用于其他交易。BNY首席创新与市场转型官Carolyn Weinberg表示，在结算和融资两个环节都使用美国国债的代币化表示，可以实现一个更互联、更高效、全天候运行的金融体系。
current_state.en:
BNY, described as the world's largest custody bank, and trading firm Citadel Securities said on Tuesday they had completed a transaction using tokenized U.S. Treasuries, showing how blockchain-based government bonds could move from settlement into financing. BNY also said it plans to add digital cash and tokenized deposit capabilities and to extend the operating hours of its traditional settlement systems for Federal Reserve-eligible securities and U.S. triparty transactions, with the aim of reaching European and Asian trading hours next year.

The effort targets a key bottleneck in financial markets: moving government bonds used as collateral for trading and borrowing can take time, tying up assets that could otherwise be put to work. Citadel Securities digital assets operations lead Dan Doherty said efficient movement of high-quality collateral is fundamental to well-functioning markets and that reducing delays across the trade lifecycle could improve how institutional markets operate.

The transaction was a demonstration of how tokenized government bonds could move from settlement into financing, potentially letting firms reuse collateral sooner and free up cash for other trades. BNY chief innovation and market transformation officer Carolyn Weinberg said using a tokenized representation of a U.S. Treasury across both settlement and financing enables a more connected, efficient and always-on financial system.

updates.background_zh: 华尔街一直在探索将传统资产引入区块链，贝莱德、富兰克林邓普顿和摩根大通等机构已采用代币化基金和证券，押注该技术能够缩短结算时间、实现流程自动化并让资产更易流转。BNY本身也在布局数字资产基础设施，包括为USDC稳定币提供托管和发行支持，并表示计划将支持范围扩展至其他稳定币发行方和数字现金服务。代币化美国国债是政府债务（如短期国库券）的区块链化表示形式。
updates.background_en: Wall Street has been exploring bringing traditional assets onto blockchains, with firms including BlackRock, Franklin Templeton and JPMorgan embracing tokenized funds and securities on bets the technology can shorten settlement times, automate processes and make assets easier to move. BNY has separately moved into digital asset infrastructure, including custody and issuance support for the USDC stablecoin, and has said it plans to extend support to other stablecoin issuers and digital cash services. Tokenized U.S. Treasuries are blockchain-based representations of government debt such as short-term Treasury bills.
updates.market_impact_zh: 这笔交易属于代币化现实世界资产与抵押品领域：如果代币化国债能够在结算与融资通道之间流转，就可能触及回购和三方交易中的抵押品流动，而这些环节正使用USDC等数字现金工具进行结算，这也是大型托管机构和稳定币发行方正在建设的通道。上述计划仍处于试点阶段，并取决于BNY能否扩展数字现金服务和结算时间。
updates.market_impact_en: The transaction sits in the tokenized real-world asset and collateral segment: if tokenized Treasuries can move between settlement and financing rails, they could touch repo and triparty collateral flows where USDC and other digital cash instruments are used for settlement, a channel that large custodians and stablecoin issuers are already building toward. The described plans remain pilot-stage and depend on BNY extending digital cash services and settlement hours.
